hero.jcr:title: Flying with infants and children
hero.intro: Young travellers are always welcome on board. Here is what you need to know about flying with babies and children, from making the booking to settling in for the flight.

accordion.sectionIntro: How to book a baby on a flight, and whether they need their own seat, a bassinet or can sit on your lap.

item_1.text:
An infant can fly on the ticket of a parent or guardian when they sit on that adult's lap.

If you want your infant to have a seat of their own, they need a separate ticket. Contact us to book it.

Bassinets are only offered on domestic flights operated by A330 aircraft. Ask for one at check-in; they are subject to availability.

item_2.text:
Every infant needs their own ticket on an international flight. The ticket does not include a seat.

  • Your infant travels on your lap, or in a bassinet if you booked one and the crew say it is safe to use.
  • An infant under 2 who does not use a seat pays 10% of the adult fare.
  • Each adult can travel with one infant on their lap.

item_3.cq:panelTitle: Booking a seat for your infant
item_3.text:
Infants under 2 do not need a seat. If you would like one for your infant, contact us or your travel agent. Seats for infants cannot be booked online, and a discounted fare applies.

An infant in their own seat must travel in an approved child car seat or restraint.

item_4.cq:panelTitle: Travelling with more than one infant per adult
item_4.text:
You can book one infant per adult online.

Each extra infant travelling with the same adult needs their own seat and an approved child car seat or restraint. Contact us to make this booking.

item_5.cq:panelTitle: How soon can infants travel after birth?
item_5.text:
• Up to 48 hours old: too young to fly.
  • 3 to 7 days old: can fly with medical clearance.
  • 8 days or older: healthy infants can fly without clearance. Infants born early or with complications need medical clearance.

Allow at least 48 hours for a clearance request to be approved.

item_6.cq:panelTitle: My infant isn't born yet, how do I book?
item_6.text: Book your own flights now. Once your baby is born, contact us to add them to the booking and issue their ticket if they need one.
